content.text: Jacque and LaTroy couldn’t believe that Smoker? Smokey? has retired. Hope you and especially Anne are well.

“Smoker”, as in “Pole Smoker”, is what we used to call each other. I used to call LaTroy, “Pillow Biter” as well. If you are with those two I would advise you to run the other direction as fast as far as your legs will carry you.  Haha. Those guys are two of my all time favorites.  I will definitely miss times like the one you just had with those two characters. Anne got a good report during her last visit and we are praying that she remains in remission. Appreciate the note Partner, good luck out there. If all goes as planned, this time next year should be very exciting times for everyone involved with the Detroit Tigers.
